STAMP ACT 1949

STAMP DUTY (REMISSION) (NO. 3) ORDER 2002

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 80(2) of the Stamp Act 1949

[Act 378], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

JADUAL PERTAMA

(a) Semua surat cara Perjanjian Jual Beli yang disempurnakan antara

pembeli dengan Pengurusan Danaharta Nasional Berhad atau anakanak syarikat milik penuhnya pada atau selepas 1 Januari 2002 tetapi

tidak lewat daripada 31 Disember 2003.

(b) Semua surat cara yang menguatkuasakan pindah hakmilik harta itu

daripada Pengurusan Danaharta Nasional Berhad atau anak-anak syarikat

milik penuhnya kepada pembeli yang dinamakan dalam Perjanjian

Jual Beli yang disebut dalam perenggan (a).

(c) Semua surat cara dalam bentuk cagaran yang disempurnakan antara

pembeli yang dinamakan dalam Perjanjian Jual Beli dalam perenggan

(a) dengan suatu bank atau institusi kewangan atau majikan di bawah

suatu skim pinjaman perumahan untuk pekerja bagi tujuan membiayai

pembelian harta itu.

JADUAL KEDUA

Danaharta Managers Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Managers (L) Ltd.

Danaharta Urus Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Hartanah Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Bina Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Ekuiti Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Industri Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Kredit Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Prasarana Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Perhotelan Sdn. Bhd.

Dibuat 8 April 2002.

[Perb. CR. (8.20) 116/1-138(SJ 18); LHDN. 01/34/42/68-180-1(7/02);

PN(PU2)159/XXVI]

STAMP ACT 1949

STAMP DUTY (EXEMPTION) (NO. 19) ORDER 2002

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 80(1) of the Stamp Act 1949

[Act 378], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Stamp Duty (Exemption) (No. 19)

Order 2002.

(2) This Order shall be deemed to have come into operation on 1 January

P.U. (A) 157.

Exemption

2. The instruments specified in the First Schedule for the purchase of property

from Pengurusan Danaharta Nasional Berhad or its fully-owned subsidiary

companies as specified in the Second Schedule, sold during the period between

1 January 2002 to 31 December 2003 are exempted from stamp duty.

FIRST SCHEDULE

(a) All instruments of Sale and Purchase Agreement executed between

the purchaser and Pengurusan Danaharta Nasional Berhad or its fullyowned subsidiary companies on or after 1 January 2002 but not later

than 31 December 2003.

(b) All instruments effecting the transfer of title of the property from

Pengurusan Danaharta Nasional Berhad or its fully-owned subsidiary

companies to the purchaser named in the Sale and Purchase Agreement mentioned in paragraph (a).

(c) All instruments in the nature of security executed between the purchaser named in the Sale and Purchase Agreement mentioned in

paragraph (a) and a bank or financial institution or employer under

an employee housing loan scheme for the purpose of financing the

purchase of the property.

SECOND SCHEDULE

Danaharta Managers Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Managers (L) Ltd.

Danaharta Urus Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Hartanah Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Bina Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Ekuiti Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Industri Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Kredit Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Prasarana Sdn. Bhd.

Danaharta Perhotelan Sdn. Bhd.

Made 8 April 2002.

[Perb. CR. (8.20) 116/1-138(SJ 18); LHDN. 01/34/42/68-180-1(7/02);

PN(PU2

)159/XXVI]

On behalf and in the name of the Minister of Finance,

CHAN KONG CHOY

Deputy Minister of Finance

P.U. (A) 157.

REAL PROPERTY GAINS TAX ACT 1976

REAL PROPERTY GAINS TAX (EXEMPTION) (NO. 3) ORDER 2002

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 9(3) of the Real Property

Gains Tax Act 1976 [Act 169], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Real Property Gains Tax (Exemption)

(No. 3) Order 2002.

Exemption

2. The Minister exempts Arab-Malaysian Finance Berhad (AMFB) and MBf

Finance Berhad (MBf Finance) from the payment of real property gains tax in

respect of chargeable gains accruing on the disposal of all chargeable assets in

connection with a merger scheme pursuant to the Sale and Purchase Agreement

dated 3 August 2001.

Made 8 April 2002.

AKTA PERLEMBAGAAN (PINDAAN) 2000

PERINTAH WILAYAH PERSEKUTUAN PUTRAJAYA

(UBAHSUAIAN KANUN TANAH NEGARA) 2001

PEMBETULAN

DALAM P.U. (A) 213 yang disiarkan pada 23 Julai 2001—

(a) gantikan perkataan "2000" yang terdapat dalam tajuk dan mukadimah

dengan perkataan "2001"; dan

(b) dalam teks bahasa kebangsaan, gantikan perkataan "ubahsuaian"

di mana-mana jua terdapat dengan perkataan "ubah suaian".

CONSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ACT 2000

FEDERAL TERRITORY OF PUTRAJAYA

(MODIFICATION OF NATIONAL LAND CODE) ORDER 2001

CORRIGENDUM

IN P.U. (A) 213 published on 23 July 2001—

(a) substitute for the word "2000" appearing in the title and the preamble

the word "2001"; and

(b) in the national language text, substitute for the word "ubahsuaian"

wherever appearing the words "ubah suaian".

[JPM. WPLK(S): 01/682/I; PN(PU2)609]
